test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

To put off doing something, especially out of habitual carelessness or laziness
solution: The correct answer is: **Procrastinate ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Procrastinate **means to delay or postpone something, especially out of laziness or carelessness. (किसी चीज़ में देरी करना या स्थगित करना, विशेषकर आलस्य या लापरवाही के कारण) • It is a verb and can be used in sentences like "*I always procrastinate when it comes to studying for exams.*" • The word comes from the Latin word "procrastinare" which means "to put off until tomorrow." • Other synonyms for procrastinate include delay, postpone, defer, and dilly-dally. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Accelerate **means to increase the speed or rate of something. (किसी चीज़ की गति या दर बढ़ाना) • **Lacerate **means to tear or cut deeply, usually referring to flesh or skin. (गहराई से फाड़ना या काटना, आमतौर पर मांस या त्वचा का जिक्र होता है) • **Recuperate **means to recover from illness or injury. (बीमारी या चोट से उबरना) 1b9:Ta87, The correct answer is: **Frequently **
